Trusted savings should not remain invisible.
Many groups still depend on cash, notebooks, spreadsheets, WhatsApp messages or one person's mobile-money account. This makes reconciliation difficult, weakens transparency and prevents years of savings discipline from becoming a recognised financial record.
Manual contribution tracking
Missing or disputed records
Cash-handling and fraud risk
No independent member statements
Capital repeatedly distributed rather than accumulated
Limited visibility for banks and other partners
How Collect works
01
Create the group
Private-group creation is available only on eligible Android builds, after SMS consent and device verification. iOS and web do not create private groups.
02
Invite members
Use a private link or QR code. Member operations require a complete Rwanda MoMo profile.
03
Approve in USSD
Eligible Android members check the exact MTN MoMo or Airtel Money receiver and whole-RWF amount, then approve payment in the mobile network’s USSD prompt.
04
Review the record
A pending request or receipt SMS is not a confirmed contribution. Production confirmation requires independently reconciled settlement evidence or an explicitly approved constrained finality policy.
05
Future directions
Partner-led credit and insurance are not available through the current app. Contact IKANISA for information.
Features for groups that save together
Transparent group ledger
Reconciled contributions are allocated to the authorized member and group.
Member records
Members review personal contribution activity within their permissions.
Group purpose
Groups keep their own agreed contribution purpose and rules.
Role controls
Authorized group roles see appropriate records; private details remain protected.
Purpose-based goals
A group can contribute toward school fees, assets or emergencies. Naming a purpose does not provide insurance, credit or an investment product.
Basic-phone plans
A standalone basic-phone Collect journey is planned and is not currently available. The app’s Android USSD handoff is not a basic-phone Collect service.
No custody
Collect never asks for a MoMo PIN or payment provider OTP and does not hold customer funds. Your WhatsApp sign-in code is only for signing in to Collect.
Credit direction
Loans, bank deposits, collateral arrangements and loan repayments are provider-dependent directions, not services available through the current Collect app. No lender arrangement, eligibility or approval is promised.
From rotation to accumulation - keep the trust, grow the capital.
Groups choose their own rotation or accumulation rules. Collect records contributions; it does not hold group capital, establish collateral, provide investments or promise credit. Any financial arrangement needs separate supported provider terms.
Each group chooses its rules.
Collect does not force groups to abandon their existing culture or governance.

Why current insurance misses informal earners
Annual risks cannot always be funded with one large annual payment. Informal earners may understand the need for insurance but struggle with premiums and processes designed around regular monthly salaries. Insurers also face high costs when collecting many small payments and servicing customers outside traditional channels.

How Collect protects customer information
Collect limits access to customer data by role and reason, protects data in transit, keeps operational audit trails, and minimises raw sensitive records where possible.
Personal data is not sold.
Customer funds are not held on Collect's own balance sheet.
Banks and insurers make their own regulated decisions.
Customer deletion and correction routes are available through app and support channels.
What Collect will not do
Collect does not make final loan, pricing, policy or claim decisions for regulated providers, and it does not expose private credit-readiness documents to group members.
No public training of private customer financial documents.
No sale of personal data.
No public promise of automatic credit, insurance or payout approval.
No unrestricted access to sensitive support records.
Partner and regulated-product boundary
Collect supports records, preparation, communication and customer-requested workflows. Licensed banks, insurers or approved providers remain responsible for their own KYC, AML/CFT, eligibility, pricing, approval, disbursement, claim and regulatory obligations.
Provider review remains separate from Collect public marketing copy.
Funds are handled through regulated financial-service partners where approved arrangements apply.
Partner handoff requires an appropriate legal basis and customer workflow.
Customer rights and deletion support
Customers can request access, correction, account deletion or data deletion. Some ledger, security, dispute, payment, tax, audit, legal or regulatory records may need limited retention.
Use the in-app account deletion request where available.
Contact WhatsApp support at +250 795 588 248.
Email info@ikanisa.com for privacy or deletion questions.
Support can confirm request status and explain retained record categories.
